flag.note: A Zacks summary of Microsoft's latest quarter says operating cash flow was $58 billion, up 29% from a year earlier, so it did not fall.
Search revenue grew 12% in Q3 2026, missing estimates but well above the 5% trigger. Growth has slowed from 17% and 19% earlier this year.
AWS grew 39.3% in Q3 2026, near a five-year high, not halved. I found no report of a large AI customer failing to pay.
Backlog was $10.9 billion at fiscal Q3 2026, below $11.4 billion at the end of fiscal 2025. The fiscal Q4 report is not out yet. No customer failure found.
Backlog hit a record $8.2 billion in Q3 2026, up from $7.8 billion at the end of 2025. No large customer failure found.
China rose to 23% of system sales in Q3 2026, and Washington is pressing the Dutch government to tighten limits. No new limits or order cuts found yet.
October 2026 revenue was up 59.7% from a year earlier, and TSMC is adding a 3-nanometer plant for a key customer. No order cuts found.
Guarantees rose to $118 billion and customer receivables to $81 billion. Nvidia says none have been called and no major customer has failed to pay.
Q3 2026 brought record orders and backlog, with electrical backlog up 46% and data-center orders more than doubled over 12 months. No cancellations found.
